about_the_game:
Step into Elicion — a hand-crafted action-adventure RPG brimming with danger, mystery, and untold secrets.

As the ancient Crystals of Power resurface after centuries of silence, the balance of magic begins to unravel. Darkness spreads across the land, and four unlikely heroes — Hiro, Sasha, Ruby, and Malus — must rise to restore order before it's too late.

⚔️ Gameplay & Features:

  • Real-time combat with fluid melee and elemental magic. Each hero has a unique fighting style and special abilities.

  • Explore a vast, handcrafted world — from ancient ruins and enchanted forests to mountain fortresses and lost cities.

  • 100 unique collectibles scattered across the world, waiting to be discovered by curious players.

  • Environmental puzzles and hidden paths that reward exploration and observation.

  • Challenging boss battles that demand strategy, timing, and clever use of each hero's powers.

  • Story-rich quests with meaningful dialogue and character development. While your choices don’t alter the ending, they deepen the world and relationships.

  • Quest-based rewards that offer new paths, lore, and helpful tools for your journey.

  • 25–30 hours of gameplay in the main questline, with even more to discover through side quests and exploration.

  • Immersive fantasy soundtrack designed to enhance every moment of your adventure.

  • Full controller and keyboard/mouse support, with customizable input options.

Uncover the lost history of Elicion, face the shadows of its past, and forge your legacy in this single-player, story-driven fantasy adventure. The fate of the realm lies in your hands — will you answer the call?
